status: published prototype parameter model; not calibration of the user's modified hardware
parameter_source: Table II on printed page 6672; equations 4-9 on pages 6672-6673; mass in abstract; geometry in Figure 3
linear_drag: not added; the published model specifies quadratic drag
marine_bow_crossflow_factor: 1.078 exp(-1.654 u), equation 8; forward-motion operating domain
notes: Added coefficients are stored as positive magnitudes. The paper prints negative derivatives and subtracts them from rigid mass/inertia.
The printed rotational drag row uses translational-speed units. The implementation applies its coefficients to angular rates as equation 5 specifies and flags this dimensional typesetting ambiguity.
Local mesh geometry is an appearance reference. Local conflicting masses, inertias, damping and lever arms are not silently mixed into this parameter model.
Actuator curves and simulation command ranges are separately digitized from Figure 5, with digitization error recorded. These are not new thrust measurements.
A continuously varying immersion fraction and motor response times are implementation assumptions, separately logged from Table II.
